➔ What we do

Integrated commercial openings, security, and technology— delivered as one.

CBX Solutions brings doors, frames, hardware, security, and network technology together under one
coordinated approach, so complex commercial buildings work better from day one through long-term
operation. Backed by decades of trust and local experts across a national network, we simplify
complexity, reduce risk, and deliver accountability at every stage of the building lifecycle.

[Complete opening solutions, done right.]
➔ Doors, Frames, and Hardware

Complete opening solutions, done right.

CBX Solutions delivers comprehensive doors, frames, and hardware expertise for commercial
environments of every scale. From specification support and code compliance to project management,
fabrication, installation, and service, we ensure openings perform as designed—safely, reliably, and
without surprises. Our teams work closely with architects, contractors, and owners to coordinate
details early and protect outcomes throughout the project lifecycle.
[Learn More][11]
➔ Systems Integration

Access, protection, and intelligence aligned.

We design and deliver integrated security solutions that connect physical access with intelligent
control. From electronic access control and video surveillance to software and system integration,
CBX Solutions helps protect people, property, and operations. Our coordinated approach ensures
security systems are designed to work with openings—not around them—creating safer, smarter
environments.
[Learn More][12]
[Access, protection, and intelligence aligned.]
[The infrastructure that keeps buildings connected.]
➔ Network Solutions and A/V

The infrastructure that keeps buildings connected.

CBX Solutions supports structured cabling, network infrastructure, and A/V systems that power modern
buildings. Our teams align technology planning with physical environments to ensure reliability,
scalability, and long-term performance. Whether supporting new construction or ongoing operations,
we help keep systems connected, coordinated, and future-ready.

[Learn More][13]
➔ Specialty Solutions

The details that make buildings work.

Beyond doors and hardware, many projects require additional components that support day-to-day
functionality. CBX Solutions provides specialty products such as operable partitions, toilet
partitions, lockers, and other architectural specialties. These systems support the spaces people
use every day and play a critical role in how a building operates. 

[Learn More][14]

➔ What we do

Integrated commercial openings, security, and technology— delivered as one.

CBX Solutions brings doors, frames, hardware, security, and network technology together under one
coordinated approach, so complex commercial buildings work better from day one through long-term
operation. Backed by decades of trust and local experts across a national network, we simplify
complexity, reduce risk, and deliver accountability at every stage of the building lifecycle.

[Complete opening solutions, done right.]
➔ Doors, Frames, and Hardware

Complete opening solutions, done right.

CBX Solutions delivers comprehensive doors, frames, and hardware expertise for commercial
environments of every scale. From specification support and code compliance to project management,
fabrication, installation, and service, we ensure openings perform as designed—safely, reliably, and
without surprises. Our teams work closely with architects, contractors, and owners to coordinate
details early and protect outcomes throughout the project lifecycle.
[Learn More][11]
➔ Systems Integration

Access, protection, and intelligence aligned.

We design and deliver integrated security solutions that connect physical access with intelligent
control. From electronic access control and video surveillance to software and system integration,
CBX Solutions helps protect people, property, and operations. Our coordinated approach ensures
security systems are designed to work with openings—not around them—creating safer, smarter
environments.
[Learn More][12]
[Access, protection, and intelligence aligned.]
[The infrastructure that keeps buildings connected.]
➔ Network Solutions and A/V

The infrastructure that keeps buildings connected.

CBX Solutions supports structured cabling, network infrastructure, and A/V systems that power modern
buildings. Our teams align technology planning with physical environments to ensure reliability,
scalability, and long-term performance. Whether supporting new construction or ongoing operations,
we help keep systems connected, coordinated, and future-ready.

[Learn More][13]
➔ Specialty Solutions

The details that make buildings work.

Beyond doors and hardware, many projects require additional components that support day-to-day
functionality. CBX Solutions provides specialty products such as operable partitions, toilet
partitions, lockers, and other architectural specialties. These systems support the spaces people
use every day and play a critical role in how a building operates.

# BESSEY Tools – Competence in clamping and cutting technology

Since 1889 BESSEY has been setting standards in hand clamping and cutting technology. Our core
competencies of research and development allow us to continuously create innovative new products
and, to improve upon our current products. BESSEY´s tools are produced from the top quality
materials, using state of-the-art techniques. This allows the highest degree of comfort, safety and
user-friendliness so that you can also benefit from our unique innovation advantage and, in
accordance with our company motto: “BESSEY. Simply better.“

## Our main product areas

## The new one-handed clamp EHK360 with a new rotating 360 handle

The new and innovative BESSEY® 360° rotating trigger clamp is unlike anything else! The ability to
optimize the handle position for clamping (or spreading) improves both clamping ergonomics and tool
versatility by allowing one to position the handle optimally for each job.

## BESSEY on Social Media

Follow us for the latest news about our products and company.

### **The BESSEY Newsletter**

Look forward to regular updates on our tools and their correct application, as well as special
offers and the latest news from BESSEY.

# Installation innovation with no through-bolting required

PFCB brackets and PFC angles deliver an elevated installation experience with durable galvanized
steel and tested load capacities. Each comes with Strong-Drive® SDS Heavy-Duty Connector screws for
a complete fastening solution that removes the need for through-bolting — so you can build with

[Simpson Strong-Tie Timber-SET glued-in rod (GIR) adhesive]

### The first code-listed glued-in rod adhesive in North America

Engineered for reliable, concealed performance in mass‑timber construction, Timber‑SET^{™} epoxy
brings ICC‑ES‑evaluated strength to glued‑in‑rod (GIR) connections in glulam. Its tested formulation
supports high‑capacity, steel‑to‑wood connections while helping streamline installation. Paired with
our complete line of GIR components — including threaded rods, centering and retaining caps,
dispensing tools, and reinforcing screws — it delivers a versatile, job‑ready solution for your next
mass‑timber project.

[View More][3]

projects. They're made of ZMAX^{®} galvanized steel for superior corrosion resistance with a black
powder-coat for added beauty.

### The UK's Premier Barn Door Hardware Provider

Barn doors became popular because they solve a real problem — allowing large openings to be closed
without the space required for a traditional swinging door. However, many systems sold today are
designed around appearance rather than performance.

At DoorMate, we specialise in barn door hardware that is engineered to work in real homes. Our
systems are designed to support large, heavy doors correctly, fix securely to real wall
constructions, and operate smoothly over time — not just on day one.

That’s why designers, builders, and homeowners use our systems for kitchens, pantries, bathrooms,
and large internal openings where reliability matters as much as appearance.

To see examples of sliding systems and barn doors we've manufatured and fitted [Click Here][125] for
our Gallery.

### Don't Accept Cheap Imitations

The market is now flooded with mass-produced barn door kits designed to look the part, but often
built without consideration for real door weights, real wall constructions, or long-term
reliability.

Many of these systems are manufactured to a price, not a standard — resulting in poor fixing points,
undersized tracks, noisy rollers, and premature wear. In many cases, they end up needing replacement
far sooner than expected.

At DoorMate, our barn door hardware is engineered to do the job properly. We design and manufacture
our systems in the UK with performance, strength, and longevity in mind, backed by clear fitting
guidance and real technical support should you ever need it.

If you’re investing in a sliding door system, it should work smoothly, fix securely, and continue to
perform for years — not just on the day it’s installed.

If you’d like to discuss a project, need technical advice, or want to speak to someone who
understands sliding door systems properly, you can contact us directly [Clicking Here][126]

➔ What we do

Integrated commercial openings, security, and technology— delivered as one.

CBX Solutions brings doors, frames, hardware, security, and network technology together under one
coordinated approach, so complex commercial buildings work better from day one through long-term
operation. Backed by decades of trust and local experts across a national network, we simplify
complexity, reduce risk, and deliver accountability at every stage of the building lifecycle.

[Complete opening solutions, done right.]
➔ Doors, Frames, and Hardware

Complete opening solutions, done right.

CBX Solutions delivers comprehensive doors, frames, and hardware expertise for commercial
environments of every scale. From specification support and code compliance to project management,
fabrication, installation, and service, we ensure openings perform as designed—safely, reliably, and
without surprises. Our teams work closely with architects, contractors, and owners to coordinate
details early and protect outcomes throughout the project lifecycle.
[Learn More][11]
➔ Systems Integration

Access, protection, and intelligence aligned.

We design and deliver integrated security solutions that connect physical access with intelligent
control. From electronic access control and video surveillance to software and system integration,
CBX Solutions helps protect people, property, and operations. Our coordinated approach ensures
security systems are designed to work with openings—not around them—creating safer, smarter
environments.
[Learn More][12]
[Access, protection, and intelligence aligned.]
[The infrastructure that keeps buildings connected.]
➔ Network Solutions and A/V

The infrastructure that keeps buildings connected.

CBX Solutions supports structured cabling, network infrastructure, and A/V systems that power modern
buildings. Our teams align technology planning with physical environments to ensure reliability,
scalability, and long-term performance. Whether supporting new construction or ongoing operations,
we help keep systems connected, coordinated, and future-ready.

[Learn More][13]
➔ Specialty Solutions

The details that make buildings work.

Beyond doors and hardware, many projects require additional components that support day-to-day
functionality. CBX Solutions provides specialty products such as operable partitions, toilet
partitions, lockers, and other architectural specialties. These systems support the spaces people
use every day and play a critical role in how a building operates. 

[Learn More][14]
[The details that make buildings work.]
[National Presence. Local Service.®]

## National Presence. Local Service.^{®}

With trusted local teams across the country, CBX Solutions combines national scale with regional
expertise. Our people understand local codes, markets, and relationships—while sharing best
practices across the network to support enterprise and multi-site customers.

[Find a Branch][15]

## Accountability at every stage.

Backed by decades of expertise and delivered through trusted local teams across the country, CBX
Solutions provides services that support your building from design and specification through
installation, maintenance, and long-term system performance.

➔ What we do

Integrated commercial openings, security, and technology— delivered as one.

CBX Solutions brings doors, frames, hardware, security, and network technology together under one
coordinated approach, so complex commercial buildings work better from day one through long-term
operation. Backed by decades of trust and local experts across a national network, we simplify
complexity, reduce risk, and deliver accountability at every stage of the building lifecycle.

[Complete opening solutions, done right.]
➔ Doors, Frames, and Hardware

Complete opening solutions, done right.

CBX Solutions delivers comprehensive doors, frames, and hardware expertise for commercial
environments of every scale. From specification support and code compliance to project management,
fabrication, installation, and service, we ensure openings perform as designed—safely, reliably, and
without surprises. Our teams work closely with architects, contractors, and owners to coordinate
details early and protect outcomes throughout the project lifecycle.
[Learn More][11]
➔ Systems Integration

Access, protection, and intelligence aligned.

We design and deliver integrated security solutions that connect physical access with intelligent
control. From electronic access control and video surveillance to software and system integration,
CBX Solutions helps protect people, property, and operations. Our coordinated approach ensures
security systems are designed to work with openings—not around them—creating safer, smarter
environments.
[Learn More][12]
[Access, protection, and intelligence aligned.]
[The infrastructure that keeps buildings connected.]
➔ Network Solutions and A/V

The infrastructure that keeps buildings connected.

CBX Solutions supports structured cabling, network infrastructure, and A/V systems that power modern
buildings. Our teams align technology planning with physical environments to ensure reliability,
scalability, and long-term performance. Whether supporting new construction or ongoing operations,
we help keep systems connected, coordinated, and future-ready.

[Learn More][13]
➔ Specialty Solutions

The details that make buildings work.

Beyond doors and hardware, many projects require additional components that support day-to-day
functionality. CBX Solutions provides specialty products such as operable partitions, toilet
partitions, lockers, and other architectural specialties. These systems support the spaces people
use every day and play a critical role in how a building operates. 

[Learn More][14]

Emtek has developed a computer algorithm, capable of generating patterns that mimic the variations
seen in nature. A limited series of truly unique patterns will be generated and produced with 3D
printed metals. Each 3D printed handle will represent their own variation of The Galapagos Project.

weight and span. You get practical input on sizing and fit so fabrication supports smooth operation
on site.

Welcome to Homewright Handyman, your trusted local partner in Norton for expert home repair
services.

With a legacy spanning over 30 years, we pride ourselves on providing reliable, insured, and
licensed residential repairs at a fair price. Unlike national franchises that often bundle
unnecessary services, we focus solely on what matters most to you—getting those pesky repairs done
efficiently and affordably. Our goal is simple: to ensure your home remains safe, functional, and
beautiful.

transparency, and unmatched craftsmanship, making your home improvement projects stress-free and

Northshore Barn Doors is your premier destination for high-quality interior barn doors and hardware.

## The St Johns Handyman

Home Repair experts in the St Johns area

If you’ve got a home improvement or repair project, you’re in the right place! All our work is
backed by our quality craftsmanship and dedication to YOUR satisfaction.

[ Request Estimate ][25]

## Our Handyman Services

### Hire Home Repair Experts You Can Trust

We provide a wide range of handyman services that you can see below. If you don’t see something
you’re looking for, go ahead and submit an Estimate Request – odds are we can help you!

[ Request A Quote ][26]

### Attic Ladder Installation

Get attic ladder installation from trusted St Johns pros. We look forward to serving all your attic
ladder installation needs. Contact us today.

### Cabinets

The St Johns Handyman offers the best cabinet repair, installation, and refinishing in St Johns.

### Carpentry & Woodworking

Carpentry can range from creating a custom home decor item, to building a dining room table, or
something special to give your home a unique look.

### Caulking

Caulking can help prevent drafts in your home by sealing cracks, gaps, and holes. It can also make
your home look more uniform and clean. Our professional handyman services can apply caulking to your
home!

### Ceiling Fan Installation

We can fix or install your ceiling fan so it is working properly.

### Commercial Property Maintenance

Our team of experts offer 5-Star rated St Johns property maintenance services, from general repair
issues to building codes.

### Deck Work

From broken flooring to fading colors, we can help get your deck in tip top shape.

### Doors

The St Johns Handyman can help with your door repair, replacement or installation.

### Drywall Repair

Do you have holes, dents, screw head holes, or patches in your drywall that need repairs? Give us a
call.

### Electrical

Have an electrical issue and need a professional? Want to upgrade light fixtures or install a
ceiling fan? We can help!

### Fencing

From sagging fencing to broken fence gates, we can help with your fence project.

### Fixture Repair, Installation & Replacement

Whether it be a sink, shelves, curtain rods, shutters, or more, we can help with your fixture
installation.

### Flooring

New floors are a great way to improve the look and feel of your space. The St Johns Handyman can
help with your flooring project.

### Furniture Assembly

We have the tools and experience to make quick work of your furniture assembly project.

### Gate Repair

Your gate is one of the most essential components of your security system that ensures the safety of
your residential or commercial property. If your gate opener is malfunctioning, damaged, or worn
out, then you should get a professional gate repair service and do it right now!

### Home Repair

We provide home repair jobs anywhere in your home. From fixture repair to TV Mounting, we've got you
covered!

### Home Security

Ensure the safety of your home with our comprehensive Home Security services. From state-of-the-art
surveillance systems to smart locks, The St Johns Handyman can help.

### Painting

The St Johns Handyman is your go-to Painter! We offer professional interior and exterior painting
services.

### Picture, Art, and Mirror Hanging

Our professional picture, art, and mirror hanging services can make a big difference in your home.
Save yourself time and enjoy your beautiful decor.

### Plumbing

From diagnosing plumbing issues to installing new fixtures, we have the experience to do the job

# BESSEY Tools – Competence in clamping and cutting technology

Since 1889 BESSEY has been setting standards in hand clamping and cutting technology. Our core
competencies of research and development allow us to continuously create innovative new products
and, to improve upon our current products. BESSEY´s tools are produced from the top quality
materials, using state of-the-art techniques. This allows the highest degree of comfort, safety and
user-friendliness so that you can also benefit from our unique innovation advantage and, in
accordance with our company motto: “BESSEY. Simply better.“

## Our main product areas

## The new one-handed clamp EHK360 with a new rotating 360 handle

The new and innovative BESSEY® 360° rotating trigger clamp is unlike anything else! The ability to
optimize the handle position for clamping (or spreading) improves both clamping ergonomics and tool
versatility by allowing one to position the handle optimally for each job.

## BESSEY on Social Media

Follow us for the latest news about our products and company.

### **The BESSEY Newsletter**

Look forward to regular updates on our tools and their correct application, as well as special
offers and the latest news from BESSEY.

# Installation innovation with no through-bolting required

PFCB brackets and PFC angles deliver an elevated installation experience with durable galvanized
steel and tested load capacities. Each comes with Strong-Drive® SDS Heavy-Duty Connector screws for
a complete fastening solution that removes the need for through-bolting — so you can build with
confidence.

[View Products][2]
[Simpson Strong-Tie Timber-SET glued-in rod (GIR) adhesive]

### The first code-listed glued-in rod adhesive in North America

Engineered for reliable, concealed performance in mass‑timber construction, Timber‑SET^{™} epoxy
brings ICC‑ES‑evaluated strength to glued‑in‑rod (GIR) connections in glulam. Its tested formulation
supports high‑capacity, steel‑to‑wood connections while helping streamline installation. Paired with
our complete line of GIR components — including threaded rods, centering and retaining caps,
dispensing tools, and reinforcing screws — it delivers a versatile, job‑ready solution for your next
mass‑timber project.

[View More][3]
[Close-up of outdoor wooden pergola beams with black metal brackets and fasteners, showing
structural hardware attached to natural wood.]

### More strength. More style. More outdoor living.

Build custom backyard structures with an array of decorative hardware that is load-rated, easy to
install and readily available. As part of our Outdoor Accents^{®} decorative hardware line,
Essentials are ideal for building elevated decks, fences, patio covers, pergolas and other
projects. They're made of ZMAX^{®} galvanized steel for superior corrosion resistance with a black
powder-coat for added beauty.

[View Products][4]
[Cover of Simpson Strong-Tie catalog titled 'Connectors for Cold-Formed Steel Construction,' showing
various steel connectors in gray, red, and blue with company logo and contact info.]

### New Catalog: Connectors for Cold-Formed Steel Construction

Our latest Cold-Formed Steel catalog includes specifications, load tables and installation
illustrations for our cold-formed steel connectors and clips, helping you easily specify and install
in commercial curtain-wall, mid-rise and residential construction.

[View Catalog][5]
Connect With Us

### The UK's Premier Barn Door Hardware Provider

Barn doors became popular because they solve a real problem — allowing large openings to be closed
without the space required for a traditional swinging door. However, many systems sold today are
designed around appearance rather than performance.

At DoorMate, we specialise in barn door hardware that is engineered to work in real homes. Our
systems are designed to support large, heavy doors correctly, fix securely to real wall
constructions, and operate smoothly over time — not just on day one.

That’s why designers, builders, and homeowners use our systems for kitchens, pantries, bathrooms,
and large internal openings where reliability matters as much as appearance.

To see examples of sliding systems and barn doors we've manufatured and fitted [Click Here][125] for
our Gallery.

### Don't Accept Cheap Imitations

The market is now flooded with mass-produced barn door kits designed to look the part, but often
built without consideration for real door weights, real wall constructions, or long-term
reliability.

Many of these systems are manufactured to a price, not a standard — resulting in poor fixing points,
undersized tracks, noisy rollers, and premature wear. In many cases, they end up needing replacement
far sooner than expected.

At DoorMate, our barn door hardware is engineered to do the job properly. We design and manufacture
our systems in the UK with performance, strength, and longevity in mind, backed by clear fitting
guidance and real technical support should you ever need it.

If you’re investing in a sliding door system, it should work smoothly, fix securely, and continue to
perform for years — not just on the day it’s installed.

If you’d like to discuss a project, need technical advice, or want to speak to someone who
understands sliding door systems properly, you can contact us directly [Clicking Here][126]

## The Spoke Knob

Be it art, architecture or interior design, Emtek products take inspiration from all walks of
life—including our daily commute. Echoing the wheel of a bicycle, the Spoke Knob is the flagship
piece in the Studio Brass line dedicated to bringing boutique design straight to your door.

EMTEK DESIGN

## The Galapagos Project

Emtek has developed a computer algorithm, capable of generating patterns that mimic the variations
seen in nature. A limited series of truly unique patterns will be generated and produced with 3D
printed metals. Each 3D printed handle will represent their own variation of The Galapagos Project.
Emulating nature, no two pieces will be identical.

Northshore Barn Doors is your premier destination for high-quality interior barn doors and hardware.

is real and seasoned.
